# Entropic Partial Optimal Transport and Gromov–Wasserstein

This site publishes the canonical, executed notebooks for Figures 1–7 of the
paper. The paper equations and Section 7 experiment conditions are the source
of truth. Every figure has one unique PDF output and a JSON sidecar containing
parameters, seeds, fitted inputs, normalization scales, solver input, matched
mass, marginal residuals, runtime, source revisions, coupling hashes, and output
hashes.

## EPOT convention

Figures 1–5 use the extended dummy-point problem (3.1). For source weights
$a$, target weights $b$, normalized component cost $M$, paper penalty
$\lambda$, and entropy parameter $\varepsilon$, the implemented problem is

$$
\min_{\widetilde\omega \in \Pi((a,1),(b,1))}
\left\langle
\begin{pmatrix}
M - 2\lambda & 0 \\
0 & 0
\end{pmatrix},
\widetilde\omega
\right\rangle
+ \varepsilon \sum_{ij}
\widetilde\omega_{ij}(\log \widetilde\omega_{ij}-1).
$$

The reported partial coupling is the real–real block of
$\widetilde\omega$. Thus the public solver input `Lambda` is exactly the
paper's $\lambda$; no factor-of-two conversion is applied. The entropy covers
the entire extended coupling.

## Figures 6–7 penalty scale

Point and mixture costs use different normalization constants. A shared
dimensionless value $\widetilde\lambda$ is therefore converted separately:

$$
\Lambda_{\mathrm{solver}}
= \widetilde\lambda\,
D_{\mathrm{match}}(C_1,C_2,\Gamma_{\mathrm{balanced}}).
$$

The paper's point-level $\lambda=0.01$ fixes $\widetilde\lambda$. In the
canonical run this gives point input `0.010000` and component input
`0.013249`; PGW and pMGW both transport $300/310$ mass.

The mixture representation reduces the coupling dimensions from
$300\times310$ to $6\times7$. This is a solver-dimensionality claim, not an
end-to-end speed claim at $N=300$, because fitting the GMM also has a cost.

## Reproducing the site

The exact Python and direct package versions are pinned by `.python-version`,
`pyproject.toml`, and `uv.lock`.

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
uv sync --frozen
MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/matplotlib \
  uv run python tools/execute_notebooks.py
export QUARTO_PYTHON="$PWD/.venv/bin/python"
quarto render docs
```
